d: Room in the castle of Windsor in the Queen's apartments. The place is illuminated. Many people go and come from all over: those who walk, those who stay while sitting etc.
Joan Seymour and sayings.
Anna appears from the bottom followed by her Dames, Paggi and Scudieri. All the places, and respectfully make her crown. Smeton is in the courtyard.
Joan returns from the Queen's apartments. She is agitated.
Henry and Joan.
Park in the castle of Windsor. It is day. Percy and Rochefort from various parts.
They come out of various parts of Hunters' appeals: everything is movement at the bottom of the scene, they run Paggi, Scudieri, Genti armed with spades, etc. etc.

All the bystanders are arranged in two rows. Rochefort draws with him aside Percy. Enter Henry and passes through the middle of the rows. In this while Anna presents himself in the middle of his damsel. Percy gradually places himself so as to be seen by Henry. Hervey and Guards.
Cabinet in the castle that puts inside Anna's rooms. Smeton alone.
Anna and Rochefort.
Anna and Smeton hiding.
Percy and Anna.
Smeton, Anna, Percy.
Rochefort, running scared, Smeton, Percy.
Henry, Hervey.
At the King's voice, the Cortigians, the Dames, the Paggi and the Soldiers flocked to Giovanna Seymour.
Atrium that puts to the rooms where Anna is and to the room where the council is gathered with Guards at the entrance. choir of Damigelle.
Anna and sayings, then Hervey with Soldiers.
Anna, Giovanna Seymour.
Courtesan choir, then Hervey.
Henry, Hervey and choir.
Anna and Percy from the opposite side in the midst of the Guards, Henry and Hervey.
Enrico indi Giovanna Seymour.
Hervey with the sheriffs who bring the council's sentence, flock to all parts of Cortigiani and Dame.
Atrium in the prisons of the Tower of London. The bottom and doors are occupied by Soldiers. Percy escorted by the Guards, and Rochefort.
Hervey, Percy, Rochefort.
Anna's servants leave the prison where she's locked up.

Anna from her prison. She presents herself in a neglect dress, with her head uncovered she advances slowly, absorbed in deep thoughts. Universal silence. Serves surround her deeply moved. She carefully observes her seems to calm down.
Odesis sound of drums. The Guards present themselves. Hervey and Cortigiani.
